mallow_title:
Meet Mugi.
Welcome to Mallow Town.
mallow_body: A gentle capybara, a small town, and the everyday things that matter. Warm, sometimes bittersweet stories about finding your place.
sample_note: Preview the first 4 pages of each book. Stories and narration are in English.
about_title:
A little reading.
A little more confidence.
a1: Yes. All books are free to read. The app has small banner ads, which any supporter purchase removes. No account is required.
a2: Books and dictionaries are included in the app and work offline. The high-quality voice needs a one-time download. Website previews and audio need an internet connection.
q3: What language are the books in?
a3: The books and narration are in English. The app interface supports 22 locales, with word meanings available in 20 languages.
closing_title:
A few pages today.
A new world tomorrow.
closing_body: Start with a story. A few quiet minutes, at your own pace, are all you need.
audio_notice: English narration uses the same AI-generated voice as the app.

page_title: Story Leaf — Small stories. A growing world.
meta_description: A little laughter. A feeling that stays. Discover the joy of English, one picture book at a time. 842 English picture books, all offline. Tap any word for its meaning in your language — 20 languages built in. Narration, level tracking.
about_body: Story Leaf helps you get comfortable with English by reading lots of easy picture books.

features.title: Tap a word, see it in your language
features.body: Tap any English word in the text and its meaning appears in your own language.

features.title: Natural-sounding narration
features.body: Books are read aloud with natural pronunciation .

features.title: The app grows with you
features.body: When you finish a book, just pick how hard and how fun it was.

features.title: Built to keep you going
features.body: A Story Tree that grows with every book you finish, plus titles earned for books read, words read, daily streaks, and completing a genre.
